head: Memoaday photo calendar app: one picture a day for iPhone
dek: Memoaday is a new iPhone and iPad photo diary that puts one photo per day into a month calendar, so you can track outfits, a child, a plant or a pet over time. It came out on 16 November and was #63 in Lifestyle on the US App Store's paid chart on 19 November.
details: The app costs $5.00. Its camera saves straight to today and shows a faint overlay of last week's photo to help you line up the same pose; it also has a self-timer and volume-button capture. You can see every Monday, for example, side by side, which the maker suggests for not repeating an outfit. Memoaday Pro adds more albums and iCloud sync for $1.00 a month or $10.00 a year. The maker, Soaring Platypus LLC, says there are no accounts, ads or tracking, and photos stay in the app unless you save them.
where: iPhone and iPad, iOS 26 or later; $5.00 (US price)
means: If you want a simple daily photo habit, this shows a month at a glance without a social feed. You pay once for the app; the subscription is only for extra albums and syncing.
todo: Read the App Store listing and its in-app prices first; you need iOS 26 or later.
